a_before_b.rationale: Preference optimization algorithms like RLHF and DPO focus on aligning model outputs using human feedback and do not require prior knowledge of model-level inference optimization techniques such as quantization or distillation.

b_before_a.rationale: Understanding how to apply inference optimization techniques like quantization and distillation does not depend on first mastering preference alignment algorithms such as RLHF or DPO.
